profile.summary: ZZ DEMO Marina Projects LLC is a UAE contractor established in 2013, serving Dubai. It provides joinery and flooring works, with 70 skilled staff and five project teams, and states capacity for projects up to AED 2.5 million. The profile lists ISO 9001:2015 quality management certification.
